title: Constrained 4-Layer with Fixed Adhesion Layer and Localized Search
scientific_hypothesis: Layer 2 (Cr) serves primarily as an adhesion/interface layer with negligible sensitivity to the spectral objective function; fixing it at 32.0 nm and narrowing the search bounds for layers 3-4 around the round 3 optimum (235.05 nm, 148.74 nm) with ±8% perturbation will allow the optimizer to resolve finer spectral features and recover toward the round 1 peak score of 0.6209.
design_principle: Reduce optimization degrees of freedom by fixing insensitive layers, concentrate search budget on thickness variables that demonstrably affect the objective (layers 3-4 dielectric interference layers).
proposed_topology: Air | SiO2 (layer 1, variable) | Cr (layer 2, fixed 32.0 nm) | HfO2 (layer 3, variable) | SiO2 (layer 4, variable) | Al substrate. Total finite layers: 4.
soft_objectives: maximize mean absorptance in 400-700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 700-2000 nm band
minimize mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Cr layer fixed at 32.0 nm for adhesion reliability
dielectric layers within typical sputtering thickness range 50-300 nm
theory_basis: Admittance locus method for metal-dielectric multilayer optimization
Fixed insensitive layer strategy to reduce search space dimensionality
expected_advantages: Focused search on sensitive variables improves convergence
Reduced risk of optimizer wasting budget on insensitive layer 2
Localized search around known good region may recover round 1 performance
known_risks: Fixing layer 2 may prevent discovery of better global optimum if Cr thickness does affect objective
Narrow bounds may trap optimizer in local optimum if round 3 values are suboptimal
execution_request_english: Optimize a 4-layer spectrally selective absorber stack on aluminum substrate. Layer sequence from air side: SiO2 (variable thickness, bounds 50-150 nm), Cr (fixed thickness 32.0 nm, not optimized), HfO2 (variable thickness, bounds 216-254 nm centered on 235.05 nm with ±8% perturbation), SiO2 (variable thickness, bounds 137-161 nm centered on 148.74 nm with ±8% perturbation). Substrate: Aluminum (opaque). Illumination: normal incidence, unpolarized. Wavelength bands: 400-700 nm target high absorptance (low reflectance), 700-2000 nm target high reflectance. Objective: maximize weighted combination of mean absorptance in 400-700 nm and mean reflectance in 700-2000 nm. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with 500 iterations. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 700-2000 nm. soft objectives: high absorptance in 400-700 nm; low reflectance in 400-700 nm; high reflectance in 700-2000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflectance in 400-700 nm; high absorptance in 700-2000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 20.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: fixed layer 2 at 32.0 nm (empirically insensitive), narrowed layers 3-4 initialization bounds to ±8% around round 3 optimum (235.05 nm, 148.74 nm) to refine local search and recover toward round 1 score of 0.6209.
